name: portless
title: Portless Active Routes
description: Instantly view active routes and their assigned ports.
author: nbaglivo

preferences.name: portlessExecutable
preferences.title: Portless Executable
preferences.description: Pick a Portless executable, such as a project's node_modules/.bin/portless. Leave empty to resolve portless from PATH.

commands.name: list
commands.title: List Active Routes
commands.description: List active routes created by Portless

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: Action to run when pressing Enter on a route. The other action moves to Cmd+Enter.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
